verdict.rationale: Better Auth's first-party 2FA plugin documents TOTP authenticator-app setup as the default method, email/SMS OTP as an alternative, backup-code generation for account recovery, enabling and disabling 2FA, and trusted-device management. Nothing in the evidence shows a way to make MFA mandatory for users or to enforce step-up re-authentication on sensitive actions, which is a large part of this story. Missing for 10: documented mandatory-MFA enforcement policy, step-up authentication for sensitive operations, independent or hands-on corroboration of the 2FA plugin.
